# Coverage results

<!-- generated by scripts/project_map/build.py from yapp_project/regression/coverage.json -- run the regression, `make sim-report ONLY=yapp_project OUT=yapp_project/regression`, then `make map`; do not edit this file -->

The functional coverage of the project's regression, **merged over every test and seed**: which bins were hit, how often and by which tests, and which bins no run hit (the *holes*). Every run writes its covergroup bins to a coverage database; the report merges them. How the covergroups are built and where they live: [Functional coverage](components/coverage.md). The bins of each coverage collector are also in its panel on the [project map](project-map.md).

Merged over **96 runs**: 57 of 57 bins hit. A percentage is covered bins / bins of the covergroup, as `get_inst_coverage()` gives it in the log of one run.

Annotated sources (genhtml): [coverage/yapp_project_tb/index.html](coverage/yapp_project_tb/index.html)

| Covergroup | Where | Bins hit | Coverage |
|---|---|---|---|
| `router_cfg_cg` | [router_coverage.sv](https://github.com/tamirgabgab/Qcom-Mentoring/blob/main/yapp_project/uvc/router/router_coverage.sv) | 23 / 23 | **100.0%** |
| `yapp_gap_cg` | [yapp_gap_coverage.sv](https://github.com/tamirgabgab/Qcom-Mentoring/blob/main/yapp_project/uvc/yapp/yapp_gap_coverage.sv) | 4 / 4 | **100.0%** |
| `yapp_pkt_cg` | [yapp_pkt_coverage.sv](https://github.com/tamirgabgab/Qcom-Mentoring/blob/main/yapp_project/uvc/yapp/yapp_pkt_coverage.sv) | 30 / 30 | **100.0%** |

## Holes

None: every bin was hit at least once.
